Race Registration Launch Timeline
Race Registration Launch Timeline
October–December 2026 Races
Please note: All information is subject to change.
October–December 2026 races will open for registration at 12:00 p.m. ET on the following 3 dates:
***NEW THIS YEAR*** Monday, June 8: Advance registration for non-9+1 and non-4 Out of 6 entries opens for members at the Member Plus and above levels for the following races. Please do not attempt to register on this day if you want 9+1 or 4 Out of 6 credit.
NYRR Jersey City 5K
NYRR Staten Island Half (advance registration opens to all member levels)
Abbott Dash to the Finish Line 5K
Race to Deliver 4M to Benefit God's Love We Deliver
NYRR Ted Corbitt 15K
NYRR Frosty 5K NYRR Midnight Run
This continued pilot will not reduce the number of 9+1 or 4 Out of 6 entries available.
Tuesday, June 9: Advance registration for all adult races (including 9+1 and 4 Out of 6 credit entries) opens for members at the Member Plus and above levels.
NYRR Staten Island Half registration opens to  all members.
General registration open to the public for youth events.
Thursday, June 11: General registration opens to the public for all adult races (including 9+1 and 4 Out of 6 credit entries, as well as non-9+1 and non-4 Out of 6 entries, should capacity remain).
Read about the non-9+1 race entry registration pilot here.
Learn more about NYRR Membership.
